provider: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin (SenMVKU), Abt. VI Verkehrsmanagement
attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin, Radzähldaten (Dauerzählstellen), Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – 2.0; aggregated to daily and time-window summaries (data changed).

limitations: Counts are bicycles passing automatic permanent counters (Dauerzählstellen) at 35 fixed locations; they measure cycling only at those cross-sections, not pedestrian footfall, café customers, or revenue, and must not be projected onto unobserved streets.
Hourly raw data 2012–2025 as published 2026-06-25 (annual edition; published once a year after the counting year).

Source legend: orange = no (0) or implausible data (excluded), yellow = no data (missing), blue = reconstructed (included, status estimated). Theme 7 marks the non-existent spring DST hour (excluded); two other marked rows (2020-10-26 04:00 and 2021-10-31 02:00) are treated as missing and their values are not used.
Timestamps are Europe/Berlin local hour labels; the repeated autumn DST hour has only one row and its handling is undocumented.
Directional counters (N/S/E/W) count one direction; bidirectional totals need both directions.
Counts can be affected by construction, detours, network changes, public-transport replacement services and wrong-way cycling (provider notes).
No public-holiday calendar is applied to weekday windows.
Counter area_code is not joined to LOR in this dataset.
